The long-standing React select control — async loading, multi-select, creatable and custom rendering.

Source: [react-select](https://github.com/JedWatson/react-select) by JedWatson — MIT.

Not a shadcn/ui project; it brings its own styling layer, so it needs theming to sit alongside shadcn.

```bash
npm install react-select
```
